name: Cloudflare Email Routing
free_limit: Free inbound email forwarding for custom domains on Workers Free and Workers Paid; unlimited inbound routed emails
watch_out: Email Routing is inbound-only; arbitrary outbound Email Sending requires Workers Paid. Sending to verified destination addresses in your own account is free, but it is not a public transactional sending API. Routing via Email Workers consumes Workers usage separately; configure domain DNS/email routing correctly.
